'''Gate Drive''' is the compact passage generator carried by [[Jump Ships]]. Unlike a permanent [[Quantum Gates|quantum gate]], it opens a brief corridor for a single vessel and then shuts down to cool and recharge.

== Construction ==
The [[Crucible Combine]] builds its field coils at [[Crucible Yard]]. Concord laboratories maintain calibration standards, while [[Free Tide]] crews contribute observations from unscheduled routes. No group can operate the entire supply chain alone.

== Limitations ==
* A jump needs a verified navigation solution.
* Energy stores require a long recovery period.
* Damage to timing equipment can leave a ship without a dependable return route.

{{Warning|Do not activate a ship drive inside the field of an operating gate.}}

== Research ==
The repeating signal of the [[Nacre Beacon]] resembles an old drive calibration sequence. Researchers at [[Beacon Watch]] have not established whether that resemblance indicates a machine, a warning or a coincidence.
